subject: FinLaunch DPA — conditional clauses & signature routing
thread_body:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@finlaunch.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finlaunch.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: DPA for Redwood — HIPAA / SCCs questions

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to start the DPA conversation so we can get legal review lined up. Attached is our standard DPA with a few conditional clauses we require for PHI-handling customers (redlines). Key asks:
- Confirm that Redwood can support HIPAA BAAs for dedicated instances.
- Clarify data residency options and whether we can flow-down SCCs to sub-processors.
- Retention limit: we request a 90-day post-termination deletion guarantee except for audit logs.

Can you loop in legal and privacy so we can get a consolidated redline response? We prefer DocuSign once terms are agreed.

Attachments: FinLaunch_DPA_Counterparty_Redlines_20271129.pdf

—Amanda
Amanda Lee
Head of Partnerships | FinLaunch
-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@finlaunch.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 16:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: DPA for Redwood — HIPAA / SCCs questions

Amanda — thanks for the clear note. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Neha (privacy) to triage. High level answers: we support HIPAA on Dedicated and Private deployments; SCCs are supported and we can provide subprocessors list and flow-downs where required.

Marissa / Neha — initial asks from the counterparty attached. Can you confirm any required exceptions and whether 90-day deletion is feasible for their environment? If we need an executive sign-off for retention exceptions, flag here and we'll escalate.

Proposed next step: Marissa to send annotated DPA with proposed language; if required, schedule a 30-minute legal-to-legal call with FinLaunch to speed alignment.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 18:27:00 -05:00
Subject: Redwood DPA — annotated reply (initial)

Aditya / team — I reviewed FinLaunch's redlines. High-level: most asks are standard but two items need narrower language or an exception path:
1) 90-day deletion: Redwood standard is 180 days for certain backup and audit artifacts. We can offer 90 days for customer data used for inference and embeddings, but need to carve out immutable audit logs for 1 year for security investigations. Suggest language: "Redwood will delete customer content within 90 days of termination, except where retention is required by law or for immutable security audit records (retained up to 1 year)."
2) SCCs flow-down: we can commit to flow-down to subprocessors that materially process personal data, but cannot require subprocessor contractual terms beyond our standard subprocessor agreements. We should provide the current subprocessor list and a 30-day notice for additions.

I attached our annotated DPA. If FinLaunch insists on universal flow-down, we'll need an escalation and an alternative: a scoped SCC Annex limited to EU-resident data and named subprocessors.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Annotated_20271130.docx

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
-----
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@finlaunch.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@finlaunch.com>, procurement@finlaunch.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA — annotated reply (initial)

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying points from our legal:
- The 1-year immutable audit log carve-out is acceptable as long as we can request access for audits with reasonable notice.
- For SCCs, FinLaunch requires the ability to review and approve named subprocessors that will process EU personal data; we can accept a narrow annex that lists the 8 subprocessors relevant to this engagement.

Can we do a legal-to-legal call tomorrow? Also, procurement asked for a signature map so they know who signs on each side (and whether we need an exec stamp).

—Carlos
Corporate Counsel | FinLaunch
-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: carlos.mendes@finlaunch.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 12:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA — annotated reply (initial)

Carlos — appreciate the feedback. We can provide access to audit logs for compliance reviews under an agreed process; suggest a clause: "Access to retained audit data for customer-led audits will be provided upon 30 days' notice and subject to Redwood's security controls and minimization of scope."

On subprocessors: Marissa will prepare an SCC Annex that lists the named subprocessors for EU data by tomorrow noon. If FinLaunch needs additional vetting, we can offer a standard security questionnaire for those vendors.

—Neha Kapoor
Director of Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@finlaunch.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@finlaunch.com>, procurement@finlaunch.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 19:04:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA — annotated reply (initial)

Amanda / Carlos — thanks everyone. Plan of record:
1) Marissa to finalize annotated DPA with the 90-day/1-year retention carve-out language and proposed SCC Annex listing named subprocessors (deliverable by 11/30 EOD PT).
2) Neha to include audit-access clause and attach the subprocessors' security questionnaire responses where available.
3) Priyom to produce a signature map (who signs on Redwood side: VP Legal + CRO for enterprise deals) and set up DocuSign routing. Priyom — please confirm routing and whether an exec stamp is needed for FinLaunch.
4) If FinLaunch has further redlines on SCC universal flow-down, we'll escalate to execs but propose the named-subprocessor annex as the working approach.

Amanda/Carlos — are you available tomorrow for a 30-minute legal-to-legal call to close open items? If not, we'll push redlines through and aim to get DocuSign prepared by EOD Thursday.

Thanks — I will circulate the finalized artifacts and signature map shortly.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
